failures.criterion: A tree already running is not stopped, paused or re-checked when a blocker is added to its issue afterwards; and an issue that carries a run, or a tree Legion takes back after it has finished and lingered, is admitted whatever its links say (spec v13 Acceptance lines 11 and 12; Fix: 'Legion reads the links at the moments it starts work: when it admits a root issue into a free slot, and when a child issue would start its first phase').
failures.evidence: Driven against the booted daemon, real Dispatch (events on), real Postgres, real NATS, at ac1d73a5. (a) Root admitted into a slot at phase admitted (status in_progress, architect registered); a person adds blocked_by [X] (X in backlog) through Dispatch's PATCH; the architect registers the design gate (gates.design off) -> the root stays at phase admitted 3s later and stays there 3s after X is closed done; state shows it slotted with designGate open and admission.blocked [] (reported nowhere). Control: the same root with no blocker added reaches planning on the same registration (PASS). (b) A tree that ran (planning), was closed done and set back to todo during its linger with an unfinished blocker is taken back and admitted (generation 2, slot held), as the spec wants; its relaunched architect registers the gate (designGate approvedVersion 1) -> the root stays at admitted, blocked [] — the exemption admits it but nothing ever starts it. Cause: Engine.advanceAdmittedTree (packages/daemon/internal/workflow/engine.go:906-914) judges every member at phase.Admitted with blockers.Unfinished, the tree root included, with no exemption; StartUnblockedChildren starts only non-roots (blockers.Holdable), so the root is stuck holding its slot for good. Red test, commit cd466040ecfe77ff62e251005e02885d9d611d1f: TestTheGateOpeningStartsAnAdmittedRootWhateverItsLinksSay (both subtests) in packages/daemon/internal/workflow/blocked_child_test.go; `cd packages/daemon && LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN=<dsn> go test -count=1 -run TestTheGateOpeningStartsAnAdmittedRootWhateverItsLinksSay ./internal/workflow/` fails with 'the admitted root = admitted when its tree's gate opened, want planning', log line 'the tree's gate opened, but this member waits on unfinished work issue=LEGION-208'.

failures.criterion: An issue that carries no run is checked (spec v13 Acceptance line 11); a root whose blocked-by link names an issue that is not done is not admitted (Acceptance line 1). The taken-back exemption is for 'a tree Legion takes back after it has finished and lingered'.
failures.evidence: Driven against the booted daemon, real Dispatch, Postgres, NATS at ac1d73a5: root R blocked_by [X], X in backlog; R todo -> waiting, admission.blocked [R waits on X]; a person moves R to backlog (R leaves the waiting line, recorded phase done, status backlog) and then back to todo -> R is admitted at generation 2 with a slot and an architect launched while X is still backlog; admission.blocked []. R never held a slot and never ran a phase. Cause: a waiting root leaving todo goes through Engine.leave -> beginLinger (packages/daemon/internal/workflow/linger.go:54), which makes it readmittable (admit.go:643-644), and readmit sets stored.TakenBack = claim.IsTreeRoot(stored.Key, oldTree) (admit.go readmit, the line after `stored.Tree = stored.Key`), true for every root, so blockers.Exempt exempts it. Any person tidying a blocked root off the board and back bypasses its blockers. Red test, commit b1cefe2b0cc115ce5e97270ebdc7b57f8b7c9444: TestABlockedRootThatLeftTheQueueAndCameBackIsStillChecked in packages/daemon/internal/admit/blocked_test.go; `cd packages/daemon && LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN=<dsn> go test -count=1 -run TestABlockedRootThatLeftTheQueueAndCameBackIsStillChecked ./internal/admit/` fails with 'the root back in todo = ... Status:"in_progress" ... TakenBack:true, marked taken back though it never ran'. The existing TestATreeTakenBackAfterItsLingerStartsAgainWhateverItsLinksSay still passes beside it, so the fix must tell a tree that ran from a root that only left the queue.
